"It's too vague to call bloodlust,{n} but I sense a will that stabs{n} right through me?"

"This presence... could it be?"
"This presence... what in the world?"

"What's going on, Alice?"

"You have done well to come, Original."

"This is a surprise. From every angle,{n} is she not the very image of me?"
"What does this meeean, Ayame dear?"
"I do not know either. No, or perhaps..."
"You have done well to come,{n} O origin of my flesh."
"'Origin'... did she saaay?"
"Just who the hell are these two?"
"They look like little girls of{n} about ten years old, buuut..."
"Yeah, I can tell by their presence.{n} Those two are no ordinary girls!"
"We are Esper Doll NEXT."
"Using technology seized from Rhodes,{n} Rheinmetall's scientists built us: more{n} perfect dolls of slaughter and ruin."
"With our power we destroy all matter{n} and utterly erase all life."
"We were sent to this island of steel{n} as the Rheinmetall army's trump card."
"We are Esper Doll NEXT."
"The prototypes the Rhodes army made{n} were left with grave mental flaws."

"Therefore, we are invincible."
"Perfect dolls of destruction,{n} governed by reason."
"Tch! Esper Dolls again!?"
"And using our country's tech{n} without asking, too!{n} Those Rheinmetall assholes!"

"But that's just too cruuuel!{n} Taking away a person's feelings!"

"We're up against something a{n} little dangerous here."

"Correct."
"The genetic defect of us Esper Dolls,{n} our mental instability, must not be{n} learned by other nations hereafter..."

"Whyyy, Ayame dear?"
"That one who wears my very shape{n} should seek {name:6}'s life...{n} I simply cannot forgive it."
"Ayame dear..."
"Here I gooooooo!{n} I'll show you the real original's power!"
"I will never let {name:6} be killed!{n} Even should my own life run out!"
"Tch! They look like brats, but{n} what kind of moves are those!?{n} So this is an Esper Doll's true worth!?"
"Th-th-that's too amaaazing!?{n} If we take a move like that head-on,{n} we'll be in biiig trouble!?"
"Mmph! Splendid, these girls' skills!"
"It cannot be...{w:1} Why...{w:1} me...?"
"Why...{w:1} To fight...{w:1} to kill{n} ...to destroy{w:1}...{n} I was born...{w:1} for that...{w:1} so why...?"
"I...{w:1} have been...{w:1} defeated...?"
"I, who have taken...{w:1} countless lives...{n} ...a perfect...{w:1} Esper Doll...{n} Why...{w:1} am I...{w:1} defeated...?"

"Anyone who goes after Prince{n} {hero:6}'s life is an enemy, every one!{n} So of course they got beaten!"
"Somehow... my tears won't stop..."
"Even though I'm not sad..."
"Don't cry, Alice."
"No... it's because you cry that you won."
"Because I cryyy...?"
"Only humans shed tears out of sorrow.{n} Dolls never shed tears. And{n} humans don't get killed by dolls."
"Sniff... sniff..."
"Then, Prince {hero:6}, do you...{n} do you cry sometimes... too?"
"Me?"
"Guess so..."
"If you died, I'm sure I'd cry."
"Priiince {hero:6}!"
"Hey!? Don't cling to me, Alice!?{n} I can't move, damn it!?{n} Hey, knock it off already!?"
"Ooooh, how I envy the lad!"
"Say, Ayame dear, are you reeeally{n} all right with how this turned out?"
"It is well."
"That one who bears my very shape{n} should kill {name:6}, to whom I owe{n} my life... I can never forgive it."
"I cannot forgive it."
"And so... I killed her..."
"One who, in truth... should have{n} been my comrade..."
"Don't cry, Ayame dear."
"Cry?"
"Seee, your eyes are full of tears."
"I see. I have never seen them before.{n} So these are... what are called tears."
"Then tell me, {name:6}."
"My chest has ached for some time now.{n} What is this pain?{n} I have suffered no wound, and yet..."
"That, you seee, is your heart{n} aching, Ayame dear."
"My heart..."
"So even a doll can have a heart.{n} I wish I could have told that{n} to my sisters who died, as well."
"That you were never born{n} merely in order to kill..."
